name: Copenhagen Spirit, Moscow (traced)
note: Traced by hand on the cached plan (1280 x 994 px, evals/real/fetch.ts). No scale bar, dimensions or areas: 105 px/m from the manifest area (57 m2; traced total 56.9 m2, 100% with the folded wall strip, as a Russian total area is close to net) cross-checked with the entrance door (94 px = 0.9 m), kitchen counters (62 px = 0.6 m), bathtub (168 px = 1.6 m) and the bed (192 x 210 px = 1.8 x 2.0 m). Slightly skewed outer walls squared off; the balcony left out (its glazed door kept as a 1.5 m door). The thick bedroom wall is traced on its centre line, with its leafless top passage as an open segment; the thick kitchen/bathroom wall is folded into the bathroom (so the envelope closes; it adds about 0.9 m2) and the bathroom cupboard box is left solid; the bathroom's tub/shower partition is dropped. The entrance hall is open to the living room. Kitchen as drawn: tall units and a sink run on the west wall, a hob run on the south wall, a short shallow counter and a bar peninsula (base units with a raised bar) facing the sofa.
